name: Saimin Cosplay Hiroba
source:
Kenji meets Haruna at a cosplay event and soon falls in love with her. He tells her that he loves her, but she says no.... Since then, his love changes into grudge.... He decides to buy a hypnotism brainwashing kit and take revenge on her.... A big cosplay event starts now....

[From Erogeshop]
